orders.text:
AO No. 40 of 2017
Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Ms. Monika Pant, Advocate for 
the appellant. 
Heard. 
Admit. 
Issue notices to the respondents. 
Steps be taken within a week. 
List in due course. 
Subject to deposit of rupees ten 
lakh of the total awarded amount, 
adjusting compulsory statutory amount, 
within six weeks from today before the 
Tribunal concerned, recovery against the 
appellant shall remain stayed. 
Urgency application (IA No.376 of 
2017) and stay application (CLMA 
746/2017) stand disposed of accordingly. 
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) 
 Vacation Judge 
24.01.2017 NISHANT

Ms. Monika Pant, learned counsel for the

2. Mr. K.K. Harbola, learned counsel holding 
brief of Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for 
the respondents – claimants.
3. Heard on the Money Withdrawal Application 
(IA No.747 of 2024).
4. Ms. Monika Pant, Advocate, submitted that 
a sum of Rs.10,00,000/- has been deposited 
before the Tribunal concerned.
5. Learned counsel appearing for the 
respondents – claimants has requested to release 
Rs.5,00,000/- (Rupees five lakh) in favour of the 
respondents – claimants.
6. The said request has not been opposed by 
the appellant.
7. The Tribunal concerned is directed to 
release Rs.5,00,000/- (Rupees five lakh) in 
favour of the respondents – claimants in 
accordance with law.
8. On the request of the learned counsel for 
both the parties, the present matter is referred to
the National Lok Adalat, which is scheduled to be 
held on 11.05.2024.
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.)
